text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Meisho 
Doto, we spotted Haru Urara by the 
riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: La-la-la~♪ Lal-lu-la~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, Doto-chan! Are you heading home now~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-That's right... Um...? Is Urara-san... 
training with shadowboxing...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: No! Singing practice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My vocal coach told me, 'Your singing 
needs more punch,' so I've been 
practicing!
choice_data_list:
That training's packing the wrong kind of 
punch...

That training's packing the wrong kind of 
punch...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The wrong kind of punch? Huh, there are 
other kinds of punch!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I think, maybe... They didn't mean 
punching someone, but having a punchy 
singing voice...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan, you know what kind of punch it 
is! Then, then, give us a 
demonstration--!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hoheh!? M-Me...!? My singing wouldn't make 
for good reference material at all!
choice_data_list:
Why don't you sing just one phrase for 
them?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I really have no confidence in this 
at all... If, if Enka... is okay, then 
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...I-I shall now sing for you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaauuuugh~~! You will never... return 
againnn~~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Incrediiible! You look just like those 
people on TV who sing in kimonos!!"
choice_data_list:
There was a real punch hidden in that 
melancholy...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So that was a punch! Hmm, hmm, I see, I 
see!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right, Urara's gonna learn how to 
punch too! Doto-chan, sing along with me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaauuuugh~~! You will never... return 
againnn~~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh—! You will never return againnn~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Is this kinda different from 
Doto-chan's~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I know it might not be my place, 
but... I-If there was... m-more variety... 
and balance...! I thought that might be 
nice... y-yes.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, moderation... moooderation~~? 
Mode-mode~, Merry Chris~~???

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, without th-thinking too hard about 
it— I just want you to sing with all your 
heart, freely...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san is s-so full of energy, and she 
has such a powerful voice...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you're straightforward... and 
trying so hard... I-If you keep at it, 
you'll definitely get the hang of it...!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaah, did Urara just get praised!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Hawawa! S-S-Sorry!! I'm so sorry for 
acting all high and mighty!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Yay! I'll do my best with both 
contrast and punchiness, tooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto continues offering advice 
while singing alongside Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After a short while, Haru Urara's 
singing voice began to change!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Aaaauuuugh~~! You will never... return 
againnn~~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! I did it, I did it—!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Doto-chan! Because 
you practiced with me and praised me so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I really didn't do anything...! I just, 
ugh, I just sang, that's allll...!
choice_data_list: Don't be so humble, be proud of yourself!
Don't be humble, hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I really didn't do anything...! I just, 
ugh, I just sang, that's allll...!
choice_data_list: Don't be so humble, be proud of yourself!
Don't be humble, hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? T-That's so embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But singing f-feels so good... I 
think... I might actually like it..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Singing is so much fun, isn't it? 
Dotou-chan, let's sing together on our way 
home!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees...! If y-you're fine with me, I'd 
love to accompany youuu~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along the twilight riverbank, a powerful 
yet somewhat wistful singing voice echoed 
out...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeee~!? N-No way! Someone like me would 
never, e-ever be so presumptuous...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You think so~? But Doto-chan, you have so 
many great qualities!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
How kind you are, and how good at singing 
you are, right? And then, and then, 
there's even more~—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh!? Urara-san has way more good points 
than meee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She's always so bright and cheerful, and 
she's even nice to someone like m-me... 
Th-There's seriously not a single bad 
thing about heeeer~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The compliment train kept rolling all the 
way back to the dorms, leaving Meisho Doto 
blushing bright red the whole time.
